agent._chat_completion.signature: (self, messages: 'list[dict[str, Any]]', *, tools: 'list[dict[str, Any]] | None', request_timeout_seconds: 'float | None' = None, max_tokens: 'int | None' = None, enable_thinking: 'bool | None' = None) -> '_ChatCompletionResult'

semantics.scope: Original Session.play thread; other calls pass through.
semantics.boundaries: After original handover return, chat entry, and each original transport entry including retries.
semantics.unchanged_before_stop: Original payload, timeout, retry count/backoff, result identity, exceptions and priority gate operations.
semantics.cancellation: Private BaseException escapes retry/analyze catches, original finally blocks clean up; outer play consumes only this patch's stop sentinel.
semantics.limitations: Does not abort in-flight work or guarantee server entry before deadline. A race remains between final client check and actual network send.

semantics.clock: All t values are seconds since observer install; original session.started_at is on the same monotonic clock.
semantics.chat: _chat_completion entry to original return/exception: includes payload build, retries, stream consumption and parsing. Includes summary calls; tools_present only labels whether a tools argument is supplied, not the call's purpose.
semantics.http: Entry to existing requests.post, then original return/exception. A streamed return may contain only headers; this does not measure server decode or full generation latency. No body/headers/payload is inspected.
semantics.gate_wait: Original _enqueue_and_wait entry to normal return, under the existing Condition: includes enqueue/pump/wait/wakeup, not just Condition.wait sleep. Admission is caller-observed ownership, not the earlier pump selection instant.
semantics.release: handover: enqueue entry immediately after original _free increment; final release: pump entry immediately after original _free increment. Neither hook performs release itself.
semantics.slot_held: Sum of admitted-return to release-credit intervals; includes model calls, Python work and idle time while the game owns a slot. Open intervals are reported separately.
semantics.tokens: Usage on successful original _chat_completion result only; null when absent. Partial/failed generation is unknown, not zero. No counters in the solver are changed.
semantics.boundedness: At most max_sessions ledgers; newest max_events_per_session events each. First timestamps and all-event aggregate counters survive event eviction.
semantics.threading: No added locks. Session ledgers have one play-thread writer; snapshot after drain for final consistency. Calls outside an observed play/chat scope pass through.

semantics.enqueue: Immediately after the original heappush, before pump; session mapping comes from the existing timing play scope.
semantics.reprice: Immediately after the original heapify; scored_at is the original common timestamp used for every refreshed snapshot.
semantics.selection: Immediately after the original heappop, before snapshot deletion, admitted.add, free decrement or notify. The selected row plus remaining heap reconstructs candidate membership at that decision, not caller-return order.
semantics.priority: Actual positive heap priority. Snapshot is the original immutable PrioritySnapshot, or null for initial admission without one. Candidate array is heap membership, not sorted rank.
semantics.identity: Waiting token ownership is captured at enqueue; selection may be performed by a different release/handover thread. Missing mappings stay null.
semantics.limits: Newest bounded events and bounded candidate prefix. Counts survive eviction; omissions are explicit. No added locks, file I/O, model requests, scoring calls or sorting.
semantics.snapshot: Call after worker drain for a consistent final report. Live snapshots are best-effort and do not acquire the gate lock.

patches.name: grounded_state
patches.runtime_adoption_counts: not collected; inspect request code and tool results
patches.freshness: live frame object and ASCII reference on read/access; detached ordinary values remain historical data
